purpose: E77原全来源支持通过后，实际登记唯一贷款需求原百分数九变量联合模型；读金融未来标签前登记
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();source=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
out=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
def readj(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
parent=readj(root/'reports/research/510300_csi300_csi500_relative_price_increment_v1/protocol.json')
gate=readj(source/'source_gate_v1_0_1.json')
assert gate['source_gate_passed'] and gate['complete_current_and_original_mature_pools']==1212 and gate['original_members_field_known']==1711
plan=parent['fixed_model_plan'].copy()
plan.update(added_features=['贷款总体需求指数'],
 added_definition='唯一原已公布本季贷款总体需求原百分数0—100，未中心化/差分/变号/加季节模型。它是银行家对本行本季主观需求的扩散指数，非实际信贷、外生需求或预期差。原公开钟/季度/信息龄展示但不新增预测列。',
 new_tree_and_ridge_fits_if_ready=2424)
parents=[ident(root/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet'),
 ident(root/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json'),
 ident(root/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv')]
sourceouts=[ident(source/n) for n in ['source_gate_v1_0_1.json','全部29当前原字段方法_目视补全_v1_0_1.json','原八字段与贷款总体需求_未读股票标签_v1_0_1.parquet','全部1711原成员_需求信息与原公布钟_v1_0_1.csv','全部1212原评分日_需求全成熟池支持_v1_0_1.csv','06_2020Q4同一原页目视修正登记.json']]
p={'study_id':'510300_BANKERS_OVERALL_LOAN_DEMAND_FIXED_NINE_FIELD_JOINT_SCORE_V1','experiment_id':'E78','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_ONE_ORIGINAL_LOAN_DEMAND_FIELD_FIXED_JOINT_SCORE_BEFORE_RETURN_LABEL_USE',
 'hypothesis':'备用流动性能力不足以刻画融资需求。已公布银行家贷款总体需求的不同主观状态，可能改变原订单/资金价格/融资/趋势/波动联合条件的剩余五日净收益估计；不预设线性符号或因果。',
 'previous_studies_preserved':['E76比率来源未通过且经济未检验','E17已知晚版本来源拒绝','E71/E72相对价格固定失败','原纠错八变量及采购/生产/就业/服务等全部失败'],
 'source_gate':(source/'source_gate_v1_0_1.json').relative_to(root).as_posix(),'source_original_quarters':29,
 'source_claim':'完整原29当前问卷字段/方法/公布页，元日期未见已知晚版本；原1711成员/1212当前及成熟池全齐，仅保守历史重构，历史首版/首次公开和独立验证未认证。',
 'fixed_model_plan':plan,'parents':parents,'source_stage_outputs':sourceouts,
 'economic_candidates':1,'parameters_changed_from_original_control':False,'new_tree_fits_budget':1212,'new_ridge_comparator_fits_budget':1212,
 'baseline_refits_budget':0,'new_stock_labels_budget':0,'new_accounts_budget':0,'source_code_edits_budget':0,'parameter_grids':0,
 'decision':'五项原主期门全过才另题登记完整20万主/2万敏感性账户；否则该固定需求表达拒绝，先全部机会信号/费用/实际路径解释，不变需求字段/差分/季节窗/参数/时期/费用营救。',
 'independent_validation':'NOT_ESTABLISHED_ALREADY_OBSERVED_HISTORY','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
 'market_expectation_surprise':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','loan_demand_causal_equity_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED',
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','only_executable_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],
 'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False,'target_net_sharpe':1.2,'target_net_cagr':0.1,'target_max_drawdown':0.1,
 'annualization_sessions':242,'minimum_naturally_completed_cycles_per_full_year':5}
dest=out/'protocol.json';assert not dest.exists()
dest.write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('E78唯一贷款总体需求九变量金融候选已登记；原结构/全1212成熟池/标签/费用/时期保持，基线0重拟合。')
